summary: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to achieve its investment objective through exposure to the top companies in the Nasdaq-100 Index® (the “Nasdaq-100®”), as represented in the Nasdaq-100® Mega Index (the “Index”). The Nasdaq-100® consists of securities of 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
